description: Aerodynamic Shape Optimization of Tall Buildings using Automated Cyber-Physical Testing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Brian Phillips, University of Florida (ufl.edu). This project focuses on the optimal design of a tall building's shape to meet competing performance objectives from multiple stakeholders, including its performance under wind loads. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: HFFB, Tall Buildings, Wind Hazards, Wind Tunnel, Shape Optimization, Cyber-physical Testing. Published 2025-01-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
